'''Vedij''' was [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[3017 BBY]] [[Seventeenth Alsakan Conflict|Seventeenth]] and final [[Alsakan Conflicts/Legends|Alsakan Conflict]] between the Republic's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the planet [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]], and their respective allies. During the Conflict, the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] under Vedij had a greater industrial base that allowed the Republic to build a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Invincible-class Dreadnaught Heavy Cruiser|''Invincible''-class fast battleships]] for use in the Conflict to overwelm the fleets of Alsakan<ref name="EGTW" /> and the planet<ref name="CSWE Corulag">{{CSWECite|I|146|Corulag}}</ref> [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]]. Despite the fleet of ''Invincible''-class ships, the Seventeenth Conflict<ref name="EGTW" /> ended in a victory for the planet [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> whose own fleet of long-range [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]], which had been produced in response to the fighting between Coruscant and Alsakan, outfought the Republic's forces.<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vedij was mentioned in ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', a [[2012]] reference book written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGTW" />
